text:
lena: pulling together follow-ups from the token-introspect outage and the broader authz pattern we've been seeing. Recurring theme: permission drift on the rotation service + incomplete audit payloads. Posting owners and timelines here so we can close the loop. :clipboard:

omar: i'll own the secrets-rotation pipeline updates. plan: add nightly dry-run job that simulates a rotate and verifies token validation across regions. ETA: 2026-04-04 for dry-run, full roll by 2026-04-10. need sec review for the service account role.

sophie: taking audit schema & telemetry. will emit user_id/request_id + auth_policy_version on token-introspect and token-refresh. estimate 1 sprint; can compress if we freeze some internal infra PRs. also will add a retroactive replays job to backfill missing user_id for recent events.

dave: i'll do a permission-drift detector. small agent that checks IAM bindings for rotation-sa and flags unexpected changes, with weekly digest and immediate alert if binding removed. ETA: 2026-03-29.

sec-bot: Reminder: owners must ack within 24h. Tracker: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2105. Escalation scheduled in 48h.

lena: Proposed Datadog logs query for missing user_id (feel free to tweak):

```
logs("service:auth AND http.path:token-introspect AND !user_id").rollup("count").last("10m") > 3
```

omar: good. i'll wire that to #eng-oncall and set pager after 2 fires. also adding a pre-deploy gate that fails if the canary check > threshold.

sophie: backfill note: we'll run a compatibility window where both old and new audit schemas are emitted for 14 days. will include consumer migration guide and a compatibility flag on the event.

dave: detector will post to Slack channel and to the tracker when it finds drift. also adding a daily report to the security mailing list.

ops: on-prem customers: need maintenance window 2026-04-11 02:00-05:00 UTC for staged rotation. managed installs will get notice 2026-04-05. air-gapped installs require manual coord.

lena: rollout plan summary: - staged swap (old key active 48h) - CI dry-run -> canary -> staged rollout -> monitor metrics -> complete swap. rollback: `./tools/rotate-keys --rollback` within 48h window.

omar: added checklist to tracker card (copied): - [ ] nightly dry-run job + CI check (omar) - [ ] KMS/service-account policy review (omar + security) - [ ] Audit schema + backfill (sophie) - [ ] Permission-drift detector + digest (dave) - [ ] Canary alert + oncall playbook (lena + ops) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

sophie: acked. will post draft PR link when available.

dave: acked. detector repo created and small smoke test green.

omar: acked. requesting security sign-off for iam tweak; pinging @security.

sec-bot: Security sign-off required for IAM changes. Please attach policy diff to tracker card.

lena: thanks everyone. next quick sync Mon 09:00 to surface blockers. If you make progress before then, drop short updates here. Leaving thread open. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
